confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates draw on crowdsourced [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Mombasa) and [Wise](https://wise.com/us/cost-of-living/kenya/mombasa) data with limited local contributions. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated using typical markups relative to beer. July accommodation prices are holistic estimates and are especially uncertain because of seasonality and limited hostel supply.
comparable_city_reasoning: East African coastal cities such as Dar es Salaam provide a regional basis, adjusted for Mombasa's mix of local dining and beach tourism.
